text:
sqlpipe v2.0 includes a breaking change to the `/v2/users` endpoint.

Update clients that read the `name` field before you upgrade. The endpoint now returns `first_name` and `last_name` instead of `name`. Clients that use `name` can stop working after the upgrade.

Use the new `--incremental` flag to transfer only new or changed records. This flag reduces transfer time for repeated operations.

Parquet writes are now 40% faster. This improvement applies to Parquet output created by sqlpipe v2.0.

Read the migration guide before you upgrade. Make sure that each client uses the new field names. Test the migration in a non-production environment. Then upgrade sqlpipe and deploy the updated clients.
